visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a large, pre-packaged food container from Costco, featuring a whole deboned roasted fish surrounded by fresh vegetables like green onions, sliced onions, and cabbage. A woman's hands, adorned with a silver bracelet, hold the plastic tray against her light-colored sweater in a brightly lit kitchen. (2) The scene transitions to a stainless steel wok placed on a white induction cooktop. Several water droplets are flicked into the wok, immediately sizzling and dancing on the surface, demonstrating that the pan is adequately preheated. (3) The ingredients from the package are displayed individually: sliced white onions, enoki mushrooms, bean curd skin, cabbage, and the centerpiece fish. The woman points to each item with her manicured fingers. (4) The camera focuses on the product label, showing Chinese text and the price of 633. (5) In a stainless steel sink, the woman rinses the vegetables in a metal colander under a stream of running water from a modern faucet. (6) Back at the stove, she pours oil from a glass bottle into the wok and begins sautéing the onions and wood ear mushrooms with a wooden spatula. (7) She then adds the lotus root, baby corn, enoki mushrooms, cabbage, and tofu to the simmering pan. (8) A dark red spicy sauce from a plastic pouch is squeezed into the wok, followed by hot water poured from a stainless steel pot, creating a bubbling, vibrant broth. (9) A bag of thick white noodles is briefly shown to the camera before being set aside. (10) The woman demonstrates a cilantro storage technique by wrapping a bunch in damp paper towels and placing them in a plastic container. (11) The large roasted fish is carefully slid into the bubbling wok, partially submerged in the red broth. (12) Dried red chilies and peppercorns are sprinkled over the fish, followed by chopped green onions and cilantro snipped with scissors. (13) Finally, the woman is shown tasting a bowl of the prepared dish, reacting to the flavor while standing in her kitchen with white cabinets and a modern range hood.
